messages:
Ari: Quick note  I'm pushing a micro-refresh to the quickstart today: unify env var name, replace v0 endpoints, and add a tiny Vercel deploy tip.
Sam: 👍 Which env var are we choosing? REDWOOD_KEY?
Ari: Yes, REDWOOD_KEY. I'll grep and normalize. PR WIP: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/560
DocBot: PR #560 opened by Ari  CI: queued  reviewers: @Sam, @Jules
Jules: Add a short sentence about ephemeral tokens for browser demos and link to /security/tokens. Also prefer rwd-1-small in quickstarts for faster cold starts.
Ari: Good call. For Vercel one-liner: `vercel env add REDWOOD_KEY` and point to using serverless backend to mint short-lived session tokens.
Sam: For the Node/py snippets, can we ensure snippet metadata uses node:18 / python:3? Last CI run failed because node image was old.
Ari: Will set that. Also swapping curl to /v1/generate. Proposed curl snippet included in PR.
DocBot: CI checks: markdown-lint, link-check, snippet-run (node:18, python:3)
DocBot: CI passed for PR #560  status: green
Ari: Merged PR #560  commit: e7f4a2b  docs build queued
Sam: Nice. I'll follow up with a tiny grep for REDWOOD_API_KEY to catch leftovers.
Jules: Thanks team  small but high-impact UX win.
